SELECT c.id, c.name, c.owner, u.name AS ownerName, c.email, c.wecom_external_id AS wecomExternalId, c.roomid, c.full_name AS fullName, c.region, c.phone, c.address, c.remark, c.follow_time AS followTime, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime FROM customer c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON CONVERT(c.owner USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(u.id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
WHERE
AND ( c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.follow_time, c.update_time, c.create_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN wecom_ingestion_message wm ON CONVERT(wm.organization_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(c.organization_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND wm.send_time >= #{startTime} AND wm.send_time < #{endTime} AND ( (c.wecom_external_id IS NOT NULL AND c.wecom_external_id != '' AND ( CONVERT(wm.external_userid USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(c.wecom_external_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR CONVERT(wm.matched_external_userid USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(c.wecom_external_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR CONVERT(wm.sender_external_userid USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(c.wecom_external_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci )) OR ( c.roomid IS NOT NULL AND c.roomid != '' AND wm.roomid IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET( CONVERT(wm.roomid USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci, CONVERT(c.roomid USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci ) > 0 ) ) LEFT JOIN email_webhook_event em ON CONVERT(em.organization_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(c.organization_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND em.create_time >= #{startTime} AND em.create_time < #{endTime} AND c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email != '' AND ( CONVERT(em.matched_target_mailbox USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(c.email USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR CONVERT(em.from_address USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(c.email USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR CONVERT(em.to_addresses USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', CONVERT(c.email USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') OR CONVERT(em.cc_addresses USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', CONVERT(c.email USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') ) LEFT JOIN follow_up_record fr ON CONVERT(fr.organization_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(c.organization_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND CONVERT(fr.customer_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(c.id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND fr.follow_time >= #{startTime} AND fr.follow_time < #{endTime}

c.id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, c.owner AS ownerId, u.name AS ownerName, COUNT(DISTINCT wm.id) AS wecomMessageCount, COUNT(DISTINCT em.id) AS emailCount, COUNT(DISTINCT fr.id) AS followRecordCount, GREATEST( COALESCE(MAX(wm.send_time), 0), COALESCE(MAX(em.create_time), 0), COALESCE(MAX(fr.follow_time), 0) ) AS lastCommunicationTime
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM customer c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON CONVERT(c.owner USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(u.id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
WHERE
AND ( c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%') OR c.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%') )
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.owner, u.name HAVING wecomMessageCount > 0 OR emailCount > 0 OR followRecordCount > 0 ORDER BY lastCommunicationTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, question, miss_reason AS missReason, occur_count AS occurCount, last_ask_time AS lastAskTime FROM ai_agent_unanswered_question WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY occur_count DESC, last_ask_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id, m.session_id, m.role, m.content, m.intent, m.evidence_json, m.create_user, m.update_user, m.create_time, m.update_time FROM ai_agent_message m JOIN ai_agent_session s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND s.organization_id = #{orgId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_answerable_question SET hit_count = hit_count + 1, last_hit_time = #{now}, question_aliases = CASE WHEN #{question} IS NULL OR #{question} = '' OR question = #{question} THEN question_aliases WHEN question_aliases IS NULL THEN JSON_ARRAY(#{question}) WHEN JSON_CONTAINS(question_aliases, JSON_QUOTE(#{question}), '$') THEN question_aliases ELSE JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(question_aliases, '$', #{question}) END, update_user = #{userId}, update_time = #{now} WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND intent = #{intent} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND review_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_answerable_question ( id, organization_id, question, question_aliases, normalized_question, category, tags, answer_type, answer, intent, tool_name, tool_params_json, data_sources, match_threshold, status, review_status, hit_count, last_hit_time, remark, create_user, update_user, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orgId}, #{question}, JSON_ARRAY(#{question}), #{normalizedQuestion}, '自动学习', JSON_ARRAY('AI Agent', '自动学习'), 'TOOL', #{answer}, #{intent}, #{toolName}, NULL, #{dataSources}, 0.8000, 'ENABLED', 'APPROVED', 1, #{now}, 'AI Agent 已能回答但问题库未配置时自动创建', #{userId}, #{userId}, #{now}, #{now} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_unanswered_question SET question = #{question}, session_id = #{sessionId}, message_id = #{messageId}, miss_reason = #{missReason}, occur_count = occur_count + 1, last_ask_time = #{now}, update_user = #{userId}, update_time = #{now} WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND normalized_question = #{normalizedQuestion} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_unanswered_question ( id, organization_id, user_id, session_id, message_id, question, normalized_question, matched_question_id, match_score, miss_reason, status, resolved_question_id, manual_answer, occur_count, first_ask_time, last_ask_time, remark, create_user, update_user, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orgId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{question}, #{normalizedQuestion}, NULL, NULL, #{missReason}, 'PENDING', NULL, NULL, 1, #{now}, #{now}, 'AI Agent 未命中当前可回答问题库时自动记录', #{userId}, #{userId}, #{now}, #{now} )
